The '''Vlassy River''' was a major river on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], running through the [[Vlassy Nature Preserve]]. Surrounded by forested bluffs and canyons, it was deemed unsuitable for farming, and had since become a major tourist destination.<ref name="GatORW" />
